Rahm brought Lightfoot in to cover up the corruption of the Chicago Police Department, which she had been doing for decades as she oversaw OPS and defended brutality cases for the city.

If she wins, Rahm wins, it would be a slap in the face to the #BlackLivesMatter movement.

Voting for Lori Lightfoot Lightfoot is a slap in the face to the #BlackLivesMatter & #NoCopAcademy movements that drove Rahm Emanuel out of the mayor's office.
